scope: Additive Phoenix L1-10 level, revival and Hero-interaction audit; retain sourced duration data without inventing damage or event ordering.
game_version: Official changes through 2026-08-30; dated game-file table 2026-09-01, exact client build unpublished; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Full Release Notes
facts: The egg follows its Hero, hatches when the Hero is about to be knocked out, and briefly protects both Phoenix and Hero; when protection expires the Hero is knocked out while Phoenix continues to fight.
sources.limitations: No exact fatal-hit interception, Hero HP state, egg position, shield start or expiration tick, target selection, splash radius or interaction order is published.

sources.title: February 2024 Update - Patch Notes
facts: A fix preserves Grand Warden passive effects during Phoenix revival.
sources.limitations: The aura lifetime, beneficiary evaluation and shield-expiration tick are not specified.

sources.title: A new Update is here!
facts: The egg no longer gets stuck in Walls; a Revive Spell interaction was fixed for a Phoenix already deployed and traveling toward its Hero.
sources.limitations: The egg path-clearance rule and exact Revive Spell interaction are not specified.

sources.title: August Update
facts: Dragon Duke finishes an active Rocket Backpack dash before defeat when Phoenix's temporary revival expires during that dash.
sources.limitations: Rocket Backpack is Equipment and its exact dash duration, path and hit ordering remain to be audited.

sources.title: Phénix : coûts, temps et niveaux — Clash of Clans
sources.version: Game-file data dated 2026-09-01, processed 2026-09-03; exact client build unpublished
facts: The TH18 maximum is level 10; HP and DPS at every level match the pinned payload. Range is 2.5 tiles and attack cadence is one second.
sources.limitations: The table does not publish shield durations, hatch timing, collision, splash radius or a paired-Hero contract.

sources.title: Pinned Phoenix Home Village Pet record
facts: reviveDuration is six seconds at levels 1-4, seven seconds at levels 5-9 and eight seconds at level 10.
sources.limitations: The field is not a verified current client-build observation and does not define which tick begins or ends immunity.

derivations.method: Lossless normalization of the pinned raw Pet payload; no Core shield, resurrection or knock-out order is inferred.

derivations.result: Confirm TH18 maximum level 10 and dated HP/DPS table
derivations.method: Compare the 2026-09-01 game-file table with the SHA-pinned raw levels.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the egg as a normal, targetable flying Pet actor
rejected_inferences.reason: The official introduction says it follows its Hero, but omits damage eligibility, collision and deployment timing.

rejected_inferences.rule: Set a revived Hero to one HP or restore its pre-lethal HP
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source states its logical HP during the protected interval.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use a six, seven or eight-second Core shield from the lethal-hit tick
rejected_inferences.reason: The pinned duration lacks exact current-build confirmation and inclusive/exclusive tick semantics.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply generic area splash to nearby enemies
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw attack type omits current splash radius, target eligibility, impact position and damage phase.

rejected_inferences.rule: Interrupt Dragon Duke's Rocket Backpack when the Phoenix interval expires
rejected_inferences.reason: The 2026-08-30 official fix explicitly requires the dash to finish before defeat.

items: exact current client build and duration continuity
egg spawn, follow, targetability and Wall clearance
lethal-hit interception and Hero HP while protected
shield start, expiry, damage immunity and defeat event order
Grand Warden passive aura evaluation while protected
Dragon Duke Rocket Backpack dash completion and defeat ordering
Revive Spell and other revival interactions
Phoenix hatch position, target choice, splash radius and attack timing
collision, visual anchors and battlefield art rights

conclusion: Phoenix L1-10 remains partial and catalogue-only. The pinned shield-duration values and dated level table are preserved, and critical Grand Warden and Dragon Duke interactions are recorded; the current deterministic resurrection and paired-Pet contract is insufficient for a faithful Core actor.
